CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetColorJsonById] ( @Id bigint ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select ( select * from ( select 'Custom' as [Name], A.Color as [Value] from Asset A where (A.Id = @Id and substring(Color, 1, 1) = '#') union all select 'Custom' as [Name], A.Color as [Value] from Asset A where (A.Id = @Id and substring(Color, 1, 3) = 'hsl') union all select C.[Name], C.[Value] from Asset A left join Color C on C.ID = try_cast(A.Color as int) where A.Id = @Id and A.Color is not null and substring(coalesce(Color,''), 1, 1) <> '#' and substring(coalesce(Color,''), 1, 3) <> 'hsl'
) C for json path, without_array_wrapper ) as ColorJson )
